title: No Game No Life: The Fall into Disboard
alt: A sky that goes from clear blue to pink over a sea of pink and white cloud. Out of the cloud rise chess pieces as high as the sky, of pale violet stone: a pawn, a knight, a bishop, a king with a bright cross at its top, a queen and a rook. A great red moon stands behind the queen. Islands of rock with grass on top float among the pieces, and water falls from them. A blue dragon with wide wings turns in the air at the left. Near us two small figures fall through the air, hand in hand: a boy in a yellow shirt with his arms out, and a small girl whose long white hair streams up. Through a break in the cloud we see green fields far below.
summary: A painting of Sora and Shiro falling into Disboard from No Game No Life in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the start of No Game No Life, the novels by Yuu Kamiya. Sora and Shiro are a brother and a sister who have never lost a game. A god pulls them into his world, and they come out high in its sky and fall.

In this world every quarrel is settled by a game. The pieces at the edge of the world are his, and he sits on the king. To take that piece is to win everything. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
